name: Community Nature Recovery Large Grants
summary: Mid Suffolk grants for larger community nature recovery projects such as pond creation and restoration, land purchase for habitat creation and urban tree planting schemes.

steps: Full application assessment against the scoring matrix

eligibility.rule: Be financially viable, evidenced by audited or independently examined accounts
Have safeguarding, health and safety, and equal opportunities policies
Provide services that align with priorities, do not duplicate services and meet proven needs
Supports key habitats or species identified in the Mid Suffolk Biodiversity Action Plan
Owns the land, holds a lease with 10+ years left, or has the landowner's written agreement
Capital projects give community or public access
Do not apply for projects or purchases already completed or commenced

status.quote: Large Grants are open for applications until 18 January 2027.

deadline.quote: Large Grants are open for applications until 18 January 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible groups include (but are not limited to): town and parish councils village hall or playing field management committees sports clubs and centres charities social enterprises community shops and pubs community interest companies

geography.quote: Through our Community Grants team, grants are available for projects that deliver clear community benefits within Mid Suffolk.

access.quote: Applicants are required to submit a Grant Enquiry Form prior to submitting a full application.

window.quote: Large Grants are open for applications until 18 January 2027.

amount.quote: Large Grants Grants of between £2,000 and £50,000 can be applied for towards larger projects such as pond creation and restoration, land purchase for habitat creation, and urban tree planting schemes.

co_finance_required.quote: Match funding is not required, though is encouraged.

effort.quote: Applicants are required to submit a Grant Enquiry Form prior to submitting a full application.
The second application window will open 16th November and close 18th January 2027.
Applications will be invited following the submission of an eligible Grant Enquiry Form.
All applications will be scored by a publicly available scoring matrix.

eligibility.quote: Applications for grants will only be considered from constituted Voluntary, Community, Faith and Social Enterprise (VCFSE) organisations which:
Are financially viable, as evidenced by audited or independently examined accounts.
Have Safeguarding, Health and Safety and Equal Opportunities policies for employees, volunteers and attendees
Provide services which align with the Council's priorities, do not duplicate services already being provided/grant aided, and will meet proven identified needs.
projects that contribute towards the retention, enhancement and creation of the priority habitats, or support the priority species.

Own the land to which the application relates (freehold) Have a lease agreement with at least 10 years remaining (leasehold) Have written confirmation that the landowner agrees to the proposed project
Funding is not available towards projects where there is no community or public access.
Projects cannot be retrospectively funded, i.e. applications cannot be submitted for projects or purchases already completed/commenced.
